paper_metadata.title: Exceptionally high strength in Mg–3Al–1Zn alloy processed by high-ratio differential speed rolling

evidence.quote: A novel route to prepare an ultrahigh-strength commercial Mg–3Al–1Zn (AZ31) alloy was established by optimizing the processing parameters of high-ratio diﬀerential speed rolling (HRDSR).
